definition: CLEAR → CONNECT → CREATE. The operating logic embedded in all TSP work.

stages.name: CLEAR
stages.purpose: Release of false containers and distorted narratives; restores authorship.

stages.name: CONNECT
stages.purpose: Restoration of coherence with body, truth, rhythm, relationship, meaning.

stages.name: CREATE
stages.purpose: Establishment of structures, agreements, governance reflecting coherence.
